title: Brain — local truthful knowledge engine
description: One portable knowledge.sqlite + Obsidian vault over a mixed corpus (docs + spreadsheets). Meaning is agentic (RAG/graph), numbers are computed from governed metrics. Includes an MCP tool layer with local stdio and opt-in Streamable HTTP.

mcp.register_with: install.sh --bundle brain --deps --mcp (copies mcp/brain -> <host>/mcp/brain, writes .mcp.json for Claude Code)

deps.venv: isolated, owned by the skills (not the project); default <project>/.claude/venv, or --user for a shared ~/.claude/venv
deps.notes: sqlite3 is stdlib; torch-free (docling retired). PDF/office parsing via pymupdf; .pptx/.docx also need LibreOffice `soffice` (system dep). fastembed uses onnx, no PyTorch.
